items.title: CVS to split into two companies, in major breakup of its $117 billion healthcare empire
items.brief: CVS Health said Wednesday it is splitting into two companies, marking one of the largest shakeups in the healthcare industry.

items.title: The historic firsts of the 2026 election
items.brief: Winners up and down the 2026 ballot will make history this year, CNN’s Decision Desk projects, including the first Black woman governor, the first Muslim elected to the US Senate and the first out gay male US senator.

items.title: Texas Democrats pull off the breakthrough they’ve chased for decades
items.brief: For decades, Texas Democrats have dreamt of turning the state blue, rallying around exciting candidates who drew big crowds and big money but could not ultimately overcome the state’s stubborn conservative majority.

items.title: A 24-year-old running the NYC marathon collapsed 2 miles from the finish line and died
items.brief: A 24-year-old woman from Lewisberry, Pennsylvania, collapsed during the New York City Marathon on Sunday and later died at a hospital, New York police say.

items.title: 3 dead, including suspect, and 2 deputies critically injured in eastern Washington state
items.brief: A shooting and subsequent firefight with responding officers left three people dead, including the suspect, and two deputies critically wounded in eastern Washington state Tuesday.

items.title: A 3,200-pound NASA observatory is careening back toward Earth. Here’s what to know
items.brief: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory is expected to meet a fiery end early Wednesday morning, nearly 22 years after it launched to study the most powerful explosions in the universe.

items.title: Look of the Week: Glenn Close and her six-foot impersonator demand a double take
items.brief: Professional shapeshifter Alexis Stone loves conjuring celebrities from beyond the grave.

items.title: Hakeem Jeffries, on track to make House speaker history, sees ‘mandate for dramatic change’
items.brief: Soon after Hakeem Jeffries arrived in the House in 2013, one of his earliest mentors approached a group of senior Black Democrats with a message.
